messages:
maria: FYI opened a docs PR to tighten up the stratus6b catalog entry: clarify which quant variants may fallback to CPU, add a tiny SDK snippet to detect runtime, and fix two stale links. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/499

kevin: Nice. Can you call out exactly which kernel versions trigger the CPU fallback? That helps support triage.

maria: Added a compatibility line: "older CUDA kernels (<=530) may not support the newest int4 kernels; server-side will gracefully fallback to CPU execution for those variants." Linked to a short note in the runtime/compat guide.

ara: Can we show how to surface the fallback from the client side? A brief example is all we need.

maria: Added this snippet to the PR under "client detection":
```
# python
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
r = c.generate("Explain the fallback behavior", model="stratus6b:quant-int4")
print(r.text)
# runtime field is set by the service
print("runtime:", getattr(r, "runtime", "unknown"))
if getattr(r, "runtime", "unknown") != "gpu":
    print("Note: request executed on", r.runtime)
```

samir: Suggest adding the p95 latency numbers for both GPU and CPU fallbacks so customers know the impact.

maria: Done: added table with median/p95 for typical 512-token runs (gpu: med 45ms p95 78ms; cpu fallback: med 210ms p95 450ms). Also noted sequence_limit 4096 and that long sequences amplify the CPU penalty.

kevin: Quick ask: add a one-line migration note for Dedicated customers about pinned capacity + autoscale. If a team pins a GPU pool that lacks the new kernels, they'll see fallbacks.

maria: Added "Dedicated migration note" section with a short checklist: verify kernel versions on pinned pools, or schedule rolling upgrade.

ara: Style nits: headings use sentence case, and keep the snippet minimal. Also add a link to the bench gist.

maria: Updated style, trimmed snippet, and linked gist: https://gist.github.com/maria/stratus-499-bench.

docs-bot: New PR opened by maria: #499  reviewers requested: @kevin @ara @samir

kevin: I'll review the benchmark methodology tomorrow and request changes if anything looks off.

samir: I'll proof the compatibility paragraph later today.

maria: Thanks all, I'll squash and request reviews after samir's pass. Also replaced broken /models/stratus anchor with /catalog/stratus6b and added a changelog entry.

ara: After merge please ping support and the Dedicated runbook owners to propagate the note.

maria: Will do.

(END)
